text.description_html:
Hagar 4501CVR-48 Concealed Vertical Rod Panic Device

These touch bar style exit devices are suitable for use on aluminum frame glass storefront doors, where there is no projection on the door face. The 48 Inch Grade 1 Concealed Vertical Rod is non-handed and for doors 36" - 48" wide and up to 84" high. Requires a 4" minimum mounting surface.

Features and Specifications:

  • Finish: Satin stainless
  • Projection: 3" - 2-5/8" dogged
  • Stile: 4" minimum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" minimum
  • Top Latch: 1/2" (13 mm) throw, pullman type with automatic dead-latching, stainless steel
  • Bottom Latch: 1/2" (13 mm) throw, pullman type, held retracted during door swing, stainless steel
  • Handing: Reversible, non-handed
  • Door Width: 48" field sizeable to 36''
  • Fasteners: Wood and machine screws. Thru-bolts.
  • Dogging: Hex key dogging.
  • Grade 1
  • Exit only, no outside trim.

Special Ordered Item. Not Returnable
